direction: Simplify details; neutral hero identity carried by equipment

prompts.ruin-sprite:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D game sprite asset, NOT a concept sheet. Reference image is only a mood, material and palette reference. User specifically wants MUCH SIMPLER and calmer than this image: broad shapes, 3-5 restrained color blocks per object, soft cel shading, one clean warm dark outline, no fine texture, no tiny leaf veins, no tiny scratches, no high-frequency patterns. Friendly bright living ancient ruins, ivory stone, sage green, teal blue and restrained warm gold. Three-quarter isometric game viewpoint, compact readable silhouettes. True transparent alpha background. No text, labels, numbers, grid lines, shadows, scenery or watermarks.
Create a single game-animation sprite sheet, square 1536x1536 or larger, EXACT 4 columns by 4 rows of equal square cells, no gaps except transparent cell padding. Every cell contains exactly one same small RUIN SPRITE enemy, consistent size, view, colors, anatomy and registration. Chubby small nature imp with a simple oval ivory wooden mask, two black oval eyes, two tiny dark cheek marks, brown wood body, short legs, 3 large green leaves on its head, a very simple short stone-tipped spear in right hand. No complex roots or armor. Facing screen bottom-right in all cells. Each character fits well inside its cell with 15% padding; standing feet baseline 85% down each cell; identical body scale across all frames, weapon never crosses into another cell.
Rows top to bottom: row1 FOUR idle breathing frames (gentle rise/fall); row2 FOUR distinct WALK CYCLE frames (left stride, passing, right stride, passing), arms and legs clearly change; row3 FOUR attack frames (spear pulled back, windup, strong forward spear stab, recoil); row4 frame1 recoil from damage, frame2 start collapsing, frame3 collapsed on ground, frame4 dissolved into a small pile of leaves and mask. Match the small enemy identity of the reference while reducing detail dramatically. Keep all 16 cells occupied, ordered, evenly sized. Transparent outside sprites.

Create one modular paper-doll CHARACTER PARTS ATLAS for a classless playable human, landscape 1536x1024, EXACT 3 columns by 2 rows of equal square 512x512 cells. SIX isolated parts, NOT full characters. Center one part inside each cell with generous transparent margin. A simple friendly chibi adult with neutral soft beige skin, ordinary short brown hair, plain ivory-grey short tunic, muted taupe trousers and simple charcoal soft boots. Absolutely no hat, jewelry, armor, weapon, robe, cape, emblem, magic or class identity. Three-quarter view facing screen bottom-right, same small number of simple clean color shapes as the simplified nature sprite, readable at 60 pixels high when assembled. Row1 col1: detached head with ordinary short hair and simple neutral two-eye face, no neck clothing; row1 col2: detached torso wearing plain short grey-beige tunic, no head arms or legs; row1 col3: detached left arm with short sleeve and relaxed empty hand, straight downward. Row2 col1: detached right arm with short sleeve and empty hand, straight downward. Row2 col2: detached left leg including taupe trouser and simple boot, straight downward. Row2 col3: detached right leg including trouser and boot. Parts must have no surrounding decorative elements, no anatomical gore, clean rounded joint ends designed to overlap. Torso square-ish, head round, arms slender and short, legs short. All parts individually centered in cells.
prompts.hero-clean: Edit this exact 3x2 character-parts atlas. Remove ALL brown diffuse glow, ambient backdrop, shading or halos OUTSIDE the six parts. Background must be perfectly transparent alpha with clean antialiased edges. Keep all six part designs, colors, outlines, positions, anatomy and dimensions unchanged. This is a game sprite parts atlas, background must not leave tinted rectangles when composited. No cast shadows. No other changes.
